nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for sustainable transportation|Biofuels for sustainable mobility_qna_000
nodes.question: Which vehicles will be exempt from the admission ban for new passenger cars and light commercial vehicles equipped with combustion engines from 2035 onwards?
nodes.answer: Vehicles powered by CO2-neutral, synthetic fuels, also known as 'e-fuels', will be exempt from the admission ban imposed on new passenger cars and light commercial vehicles with combustion engines from 2035 onwards, as specified in Regulation (EU) 2023/851 adopted by the Council of the EU in March 2023.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for sustainable transportation|Biofuels for sustainable mobility_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Which criteria were found to be most sensitive for modification of the indifference threshold in the sensitivity analysis?
nodes.answer: The criteria found to be most sensitive for modification of the indifference threshold are C1 (Blended biodiesels), C4 (Natural gas), C5 (Pure biodiesels), and C7 (Electricity).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for sustainable transportation|Biofuels for sustainable mobility_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Which criteria in road transport are least affected by changes in the indifference threshold, and why?
nodes.answer: Criteria such as __6 (Biogases), __8 (Pure biogasoline), and __9 (Other liquid biofuels) are least affected by changes in the indifference threshold. This is because they have a minor share in final energy consumption in road transport and do not significantly impact the rankings of anaanalysedel types.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for sustainable transportation|Biofuels for sustainable mobility_qna_003
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: Why does Sweden rank as the leader in sustainable transportation according to the Temporal PROMETHEUS II ranking?
nodes.answer: Sweden ranks as the leader in sustainable transportation due to its extensive use of biogas as a transportation fuel since the 1990s, accounting for a significant portion of biome thane utilized in the EU in 2015.
